name: Caro-Kann Advance — Main Line
description: The Advance Variation of the Caro-Kann. White gains space; Black must find active counterplay against the d4-e5 chain, often with ...c5 and piece pressure.

lines.name: Advance Variation — Main Line
lines.description: White pushes e5 early. Black develops the bishop to f5 and strikes at the base of the pawn chain with ...c5. A popular modern choice at all levels.
